description: This file defines the KeyboardInputManager class, handling keyboard, button, and touch input events for a game, including movement, restart, and continue actions.

classes.name: KeyboardInputManager
classes.description: Manages keyboard, touch, and button inputs for game control, including movement, restart, and continue actions.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific event.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Triggers all callbacks associated with a specific event.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for keyboard, button, and touch events.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Emits the 'restart' event to restart the game.

methods.name: keepPlaying
methods.description: Emits the 'keepPlaying' event to continue the game.

methods.name: bindButtonPress
methods.description: Binds click and touchend events to a button specified by selector.
